fields.doc:
ObjectStore is the bucket holding the tracked data, in the same form as
a datastore's spec.config.storage.objectStore. Credential Secrets are
read from the BucketCleaner's namespace by the operator itself; when
they are omitted the operator's own cloud identity is used. Defaults to
the dataStoreRef's spec.config.storage.objectStore.

fields.doc:
SubPath is the key prefix within the bucket, typically a datastore's
spec.config.storage.path. It is treated as a directory: "logs" covers
"logs/..." but not "logs-archive/...". Every object under it is deleted
when the BucketCleaner is deleted. Defaults to the dataStoreRef's
spec.config.storage.path, or the product name when that is unset.
fields.name: subPath

rules.message: subPath is immutable

fields.doc:
DataStoreRef is the datastore, in the BucketCleaner's namespace, that
writes under subPath. Omitted objectStore and subPath settings are
taken from its storage while it exists. Deletion waits until the
datastore and its pods are gone, so no replica writes objects after the
prefix is emptied, and data is never deleted while the datastore exists.
fields.name: dataStoreRef

fields.doc:
Enabled runs a startup pass over recent SSTs. Defaults to true for
readers, which warm filters and indexes in the background; Logs
readers that skip filters warm only indexes.
fields.name: enabled

fields.doc:
WarmRangeSeconds is the recent window whose metadata the startup pass
warms. Unset covers all live data, which retention bounds, and the
metadata budget bounds what is held. A set value bounds payloads too
unless PayloadWarmRangeSeconds is set. 7200, the default of earlier
CRDs that the API server stored in existing resources, is read as
unset.
fields.name: warmRangeSeconds

fields.doc:
PayloadWarmRangeSeconds is the recent window whose payloads the
startup pass warms when IncludePayloads is set. Unset uses
WarmRangeSeconds when that is set, otherwise all live data, which
PayloadBudgetPercent bounds newest first. Servers older than this
field reject it, so set it only once every reader runs a server that
knows it.
fields.name: payloadWarmRangeSeconds

fields.doc:
BlockReadiness holds readiness until the startup pass ends. Unset
keeps the server default, false.
fields.name: blockReadiness

fields.doc:
MetadataBudgetPercent is the share of the metadata cache warming may
fill before it stops; the server default is 75.
fields.name: metadataBudgetPercent

fields.doc:
PayloadBudgetPercent is the share of the data block cache that
payload warming may fill, newest first: of its disk tier when it has
one, otherwise of its memory. Warmed payloads go to the disk tier
only, so warming never fills memory. The server default is 50.
Servers older than this field reject it, so set it only once every
reader runs a server that knows it.
fields.name: payloadBudgetPercent

fields.doc: Continuous warms SSTs that appear in reader manifests after startup.
fields.name: continuous

fields.doc: WarmRangeSeconds is CacheWarmerSpec.WarmRangeSeconds for new SSTs.
fields.name: warmRangeSeconds

fields.doc:

for new SSTs.

types.doc:
ReadGroupsSpec splits sharded readers into one group per storage shard.
Each group is a StatefulSet that opens only its own shard; a query sent
to any reader reads its own shard in process and every other shard from
that shard's group over gRPC. Replicas, resources, and autoscaling apply
to each group.

fields.doc: Enabled defaults to true. When false, every reader opens every shard.
fields.name: enabled

fields.doc:
HedgeAfterMilliseconds starts a second copy of a unary shard read on
another replica of its group when the first has not answered in time.
Streaming reads are never hedged. Zero disables hedging.
fields.name: hedgeAfterMilliseconds

fields.doc: RequestTimeoutSeconds bounds one shard read.
fields.name: requestTimeoutSeconds

fields.doc:

Scale-up appends an epoch at a future aligned cutover.
fields.name: epochs

types.doc:
VectorSpec defines the desired state of Vector.

In Sharded mode each writer replica owns one shard, held with a Lease, and
reader groups serve eventually consistent queries, one group per active
shard by default. Adding writers splits shards for them: the elected
writer picks the widest shard for each new writer once its pod is ready,
and the shard's owner splits it with SlateDB clones, handing half its
namespaces to the new writer without copying data. Writers can't be
removed, since shards don't merge; the operator keeps the writer
StatefulSet at one replica per shard. Any replica accepts any request and
forwards it to the replica that can serve it.

fields.doc: Version is the Vector container image tag.
fields.name: version

the API under it too, so the Ingress needs no rewrite and the
hostname can be shared with other services. Changing pathPrefix
restarts the pods.
fields.name: ingress

pathPrefix must be empty or start with '/' and must not end with '/'

types.doc:
VectorTopology is the shard layout of a Vector database. The operator and
the database's writers maintain it, so it is not meant to be edited.
types.name: VectorTopology

types.doc:
VectorTopologySpec is the authoritative shard layout of a Vector cluster.
The elected writer and the writer splitting a shard change it with
resourceVersion-based compare-and-swap; every replica follows it by watch.
types.name: VectorTopologySpec

rules.message: exactly one of emptyDir or persistentVolumeClaim is required

fields.doc:
Replicas defaults to one for sharded writers and two for sharded
readers. Standalone mode uses exactly one writer and no reader.
fields.name: replicas

fields.doc:
NodeSelector is merged with podTemplate.spec.nodeSelector. Values here
take precedence when the same key is configured in both places.
fields.name: nodeSelector

fields.doc:
Tolerations are merged with podTemplate.spec.tolerations. A first-class
toleration replaces a podTemplate toleration with the same key, operator,
and effect; otherwise it is appended.
fields.name: tolerations

fields.doc:
Resources configures requests and limits for the datastore container.
Values here take precedence over podTemplate container resources. Missing
values default to a 250m CPU request and a 2Gi memory limit (8Gi for
Metrics, Logs and Traces writers and standalone servers, which roll up
closed days), with memory requested at its limit unless a request is
set. Those writers need at least a 6Gi limit and are not rolled out with
less. The operator holds back a quarter of the memory limit (at least
768Mi, at most half) as headroom and sizes the caches and query memory
budgets from the rest.
fields.name: resources

fields.doc:
PodTemplate is the full Kubernetes pod template escape hatch. Operator
required fields and the first-class scheduling fields are merged into it.
fields.name: podTemplate

rules.message: exactly one of emptyDir or persistentVolumeClaim is required
exactly one of emptyDir or persistentVolumeClaim is required

fields.doc:
PersistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy controls whether StatefulSet PVCs
are retained or deleted when the workload is deleted or scaled down.
When omitted, remote and in-memory object stores default to Delete while
Local object stores default to Retain because the data PVC is authoritative.
fields.name: persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy

fields.doc:
ReadGroups configures per-shard reader groups. Readers only; ignored
for writers and in standalone mode.
fields.name: readGroups

fields.doc:
Autoscaling adds a HorizontalPodAutoscaler per reader StatefulSet, one
per reader group. Readers only; ignored for writers and in standalone
mode.
fields.name: autoscaling

rules.message: minReplicas must not exceed maxReplicas

types.doc:
WriterScalingStatus reports the operator-observed writer membership and the
authoritative Rust-managed ShardMap state. Nil shard fields mean the
ShardMap was absent or could not be trusted.
types.name: WriterScalingStatus
